In Missouri, I feel like we have a pretty secure election system. My Drivers license is linked to my ballot. I chose a paper ballot as opposed to a digital one. I want my ballot to have a paper trail. They looked me up in the voter registration system. They confirmed my address. I signed my name, and they scanned a barcode on my ballot and set me loose to do my damage.

I had done my part and now it was up to the rest of the country to do theirs. All I can do now is wait.

My family and I are going to have a special dinner and sit down to watch the votes counted. We are going to watch as each county reports in. We hope we see lots of red this evening. We will have our popcorn ready. We are ready to watch the show, are you?
